title: For Emma, Forever Ago
creator: Bon Iver
summary: Justin Vernon recorded this alone in a Wisconsin cabin over one winter after a breakup. It sounds exactly like that.
personalNote: Made alone in a cabin over one winter, and it sounds exactly like that — isolated, raw, built from grief with company somehow. The lo-fi recording, the falsetto, the layered guitars: it's the sound of someone making art to survive something. Re: Stacks is one of the best closing tracks on any record.
whyIReturn: Some records belong to specific winters. This one belongs to all of them.
